notes.title: Book is Available for Preorder on Amazon! (And Bug Fix?)
notes.content:
Hello again all! That book thingie I made? Yeah! You can preorder it now! :D

https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BDWLFHQV?ref_=pe_3052080_276849420

I managed to get it out ahead of schedule, and it will be released on September 15th as promised! [strike]There are no Table of Contents, for building that is an [url=https://twitter.com/CherryCoStudios/status/1568487118275772416]Orwellian Nightmare that nobody understands[/url]...[/strike]

I actually managed to get something out in a reasonable amount of time for once! ːsteamhappyː I'm so proud of myself! ;w;

Also, one last thing...

On my last announcement, user Milla101h alerted us to the fact that they had some problems running the original version of the game. We have no idea how long that's been a thing, but today Milla101h that it is no longer a problem. According to my epic programmer guy, who I'm still not sure if I should list by name or not by now, in the event that users were accidentally playing the Revamp on the Original Game's IP, here is how they can transfer their save files...

[i]*Ahem.*[/i] For those of you "who wish to keep/backup their saves before attempting uninstalling/reinstalling to properly restore original version in the event it failed, or simply moving the saves to the revamp", follow these instructions...

"[b]Backing Up Original Saves[/b]
1) Navigate to "The Albino Hunter™️ (Original)" in steam library
2) Right-click and go to Properties
3) Click on Local Files
4) Click Browse
5) Select files labeled as "Save01" "Save02" "Save03" and "Save04" (Not all files listed may exist)
- Note: If you want to make sure you're getting the right files, these aforementioned save files will have the extension .rvdata2
6) Copy these files
7) Paste them somewhere safe

[b]Backing Up Revamp Saves From Original[/b]
1) Navigate to "The Albino Hunter™️ (Original)" in steam library
2) Right-click and go to Properties
3) Click on Local Files
4) Click Browse
5) Open folder labeled www
6) Copy folder labeled save
7) Paste folder somewhere else to keep it backed up

[b]Transferring Saves To Revamp[/b]
1) Follow "Backing Up Revamp Saves From Original" directions, skipping step 7
2) Navigate to "The Albino Hunter™️ {Revamp}" in steam library
3) Right-click and go to Properties
4) Click on Local Files
5) Click Browse
6) Open folder labeled www
7) Paste copied folder (from Backing Up Revamp Saves From Original)
8) Accept prompts for merging folders
- Note: If you're asked to overwrite files, you may want to back-up the revamp's save folder first by copy/pasting it somewhere safe, be aware that doing so will prevent the copied folder from steps in Backing Up Revamp Saves From Original to no longer be ready to paste and will require you to revisit the original save folder mentioned in those steps

- Note: If you want to ensure the files you're copying over are the right files, the files you should see in the save folder will have the .rpgsave extension, with file names of: config and global as well as any individual slots labeled with file##"

That is what he said, and you should listen to him. He's very smart. :3

Anyway, I hope that is all. ːsteamsunnyː Toodles~

notes.title: BIG FAT MONDO UPDATE...With Some Terrible News...(Update Video #12)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=zjSZwUDlrzY;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]...And just so some of you guys don't miss it, I'm going to write out my script from the video, directly into this announcement. >.> [i]*Ahem.*[/i]

I’m going to update my game! I can do that over winter break, right? :D

{SIX YEARS LATER…[b]LITERALLY[/b].}

[i]*Sobs relentlessly.*

*Cough.*[/i] Hiiii! A new update video! And a new YouTube Channel! …I forgot my password. It was really embarrassing...

But I’m BAAAACCCKKKKK! You’d thought you’d gotten rid of me, hadn’t you?! Nope! I’m still around! If you felt that took too long, then congratulations! You now know what it’s like to read one of my fanfics!

ANYWAY, it’s been a while! But I finally, finally, FINALLY finished my game! ...Again! Mostly! I…could kinda use a pixel artist or two to help me make my game not look like a blurry mess? And a programmer would be really, really nice too.

[i]*Cough.*[/i] So, what’s new? Well, first of all, after much deliberation, I’ve uploaded the revamp as it’s own individual game. (Don’t worry, though. You get the new game for free. [b][[u]EDIT[/u]] OR WILL YOU?![/b])

But, don’t worry. If you want to pay me more, then you totally can with the new Optional Additional Payment System! So now you can pay me exactly how much or how little you want! I’ve had WAY TOO MANY YEARS TO THINK ABOUT THIS, GUYS! But I THINK I’VE FINALLY FOUND A WAY TO MAKE ALL OF YOU HAPPY WITH THIS!

YOU’RE WELCOME.

[b][[u]EDIT[/u]]
Or that [i]was[/i] the plan. But then stupidity happened. Watch 1:39 to 3:27 in the video to see what I mean. Looks there is no possible way for me to give the game to all of you at the same time, like I had intended to. Sorry about that. As you can see, there is literally nothing I can do about it.

If you think you should get the revamp for free, like some of you have mentioned in the past, please send me a friend request so I can give you a Steam Key as compensation. Now back to what I had written before this had happened...[/b]

Since this revamp has been six years in the making, there are several portions of the game that were changed. (Obviously.) For the most part I tried not to censor anything, but some parts of the game have been heavily rewritten. For example, the Unworn Wedding Dress Quest is now given to you by Robert, instead of Ganguro. And I’ve completely dismantled the Frankfert Quest in favour of something a little more…logical? You'll see what I mean if you replay it.

With that said, with great rewrites come great new opportunities! So behold! A total of 24 new achievements have been added, which include 3 New Endings! Well, uh, sort of. One of them is just if you lose the Final Battle. But uh…the other two are completely new! So that’s something!

And let’s say you’re one of those people who encountered a teensy iddy biddy tiny winy glitch that caused the game to crash during the original. It wasn’t a big deal. It’s not like many of you found it or anything.

But, in the event that you were completely burned by how the old Battle System was, then worry no more! Introducing Pacifist Mode! The mode where you can skip almost every with the assumption that you win. And I say “almost” because you can’t use it during the Five Trials Quest. Or the insta-death battles. But apart from that, you can skip every single battle; including the bosses. Yes, you heard that right. All the bosses are now entirely optional. Because I know that, frankly, some of you have much better things to do with your time than spend three months grinding for some stupid battle you never really wanted to do in the first place...ULTIMA WEAPON.

This has actually been a new feature for a while now, as I added it just after my last video update. It was a feature that I was going to mention in the next update video, but, um…I didn't get around to making it until now.

Oh, and the game doesn’t break if you skim through the cutscenes, anymore. So now you can totally speedrun this game! FINALLY! JUST WHAT EVERYONE WAS ALWAYS ASKING! YOU CAN NOW DO SPEEDRUNS!

(Literally nobody was asking for this.)

And who knows? Maybe this version of the game won’t act up and corrupt video files of well-meaning Let's Players this time around!

…And if it makes your Anti-Virus go off, then I SWEAR, I’ll—

Anyway, I really do hope that my game is finished this time. Like, I’m not even you guys and even I think this is ridiculous. Like, I would, ideally, like to update the graphics and the program a little bit behind the scenes, but I can live with these things for now, because last April I was finally able to play the game from beginning to end without it crashing. Yes. It’s taken me THAT LONG to do that. I really, really want this game to be done so I can move on with my life!

But that doesn’t mean that you've necessarily heard the last from me. While working on the Revamp has kinda been my main priority, I have been working on some other stuff behind the scenes. [b]NOT VIDEOGAMES. I am kinda done with them right now because I am so frustrated.[/b] But I managed to put together a [url=https://www.webtoons.com/en/challenge/handsome-and-hideous/list?title_no=324693]Graphic Novel[/url], and I'm hoping to maybe, one day get two T.V. Shows out there? Maybe?

I would say I would want them on Netflix, except, um, Netflix doesn’t have the best reputation for that kind of thing. >.> *HackCoughCowboyBebopHackCough*

So, if you’ve enjoyed my game, I would appreciate it if you would help me out with my future endeavours. Honestly, that would mean the world to me.

Either way, sorry for the RIDICULOUSLY long delay, (and the fact that Steam refuses to let me give you free stuff for no discernible reason) but I hope the end result was worth it! Happy gaming~ :3

notes.title: Update Just With Text This Time (Sorry)
notes.content:
Just so you know, I have been working on the revamp almost everyday, however, I am mainly doing little mundane things for the time being, so I figured a video update would be kind of pointless. However, I am expecting a bit of a breakthrough soon, since I asked a person who knows how to code to help make the two plugins I need for basic functionality. So, I'm a touch excited about that. :D

However, if you must know what I've been working on most recently, I'll answer that with...*drumroll*...TILESETS! :D *crickets chirping* Okay, yeah, not very exciting. Especially considering I'm just reworking tilesets I already worked on. However, I thought of a way to make the tilesets even MORE high quality than they were before. It may not seem like much, but the ones I've been using up until this point had a pesky little pixel line that, while not immediately noticable, bugged the crap out of me. This new technique removes that. Hopefully. So far I haven't noticed anything wrong with my new method, however if something does go wrong...then I'll go back to the original method and just ignore that pesky little pixel. I've been posting them here (if Steam won't be a jerk and remove the link I post) if you're an RPG Maker Developer yourself and want to use 'em: http://forums.rpgmakerweb.com/index.php?/topic/60438-vx-ace-tileset-converted-to-mv/

Also, I made a comic for a class. I'm posting the pages stedily, so there aren't many up yet, but if you're interested, then go take a look here: http://cherry-sama.deviantart.com/gallery/58532915/I-Have-No-Idea-What-To-Call-This

notes.title: DLC Cancelled? (+ Update)
notes.content:
So, I just got finished adding in more blatant hints in the quest script, so hopefully no one will ever be thinking "gee, what do I do now?" Also, I didn't notice RogueDeus's one comment saying that the ointments were too cheap--something I already knew, but keep forgetting to change. Whoops.

And...well... I WAS working on DLC for the game, but then I was told about RPG Maker MV. RPG Maker MV will allow their games to run on Macs, Linux, and a bunch of other things--including phones. Not to mention the Character Generator is 3/4 view, and I suspect that getting this program will get rid of the pesky crashing.

Guess what I'll be working on over Christmas break.

The DLC isn't cancelled (sorry for the cheap title of this announcement), but this new version of RPG Maker definitely took some of the wind out of my sails in regards to it. At the very least, the DLC will be heavily delayed.
And to people who were looking forward to it, I'm sorry. D:

And sorry for the downer update.

notes.title: Slightly More Impressive Update
notes.content:
Okay, so, there is a new update in town! Let me explain what changed! :D

Updates:
-fixed some MORE spelling errors. (Sheesh, guys. If you see a spelling error, you gotta tell me! XD How else am I gonna fix these faster?)
-FINALLY got the quest script up and running properly. I hope. (I haven't checked yet... >.>) EDT: Just checked, and it does! Hooray! :D
-Kalymn has a new ability! Per request, Kalymn learns a new ability at Level 2: Mana Shield! This makes it so the Player can avoid the Sleep ability of those Man Eating Plants.

Future Potential Updates:
-something secret that you guys won't be aware of, but is super important to any future DLC >.> <.<
-and the suggestion of a menu option that allows you to modify the ATB speed. SakifX9 doesn't seem too keen on the idea of adding it in, but we'll see. So this is a "maybe we will, maybe we won't" thing.
-some other stuff from the previous updates that I can't think of right now.

As for that DLC mention... I've got some ideas... :P Buuuuuttttt the DLC won't be coming out any time soon, so, um... I've got some funny videos I can recommend to help pass the time. :)

Potential future updates

I'll try and keep you guys posted on the updates, but I don't want to spam you guys with update notices, so I plan on keeping them more dispersed.
